issues.subject: Floot physical office

The only precise lead remains the unit-style 945 Taraval St #534 filing/listing address, which is not independently established as a physical office.

issues.subject: Collate physical office
issues.details: The official collate.com site identifies the life-sciences AI company but does not disclose an office street address. The only exact SF candidate found was 2261 Market Street, Suite 5767 in a corporate filing, a suite-style legal address that was not independently tied to a physical office. The separate getcollate.io company lists Saratoga and is not used because it is a different company.

issues.subject: GitLab physical office
issues.details: GitLab's official visiting page explicitly describes 268 Bush Street #350 as a mailing address and not a visiting address. Its published management-system documentation says the company is all-remote and the address is closed, so it cannot support a physical-office validation.

issues.subject: Deepgram physical office
issues.details: Built In lists 548 Market Street as Deepgram's SF HQ but also describes the company as a remote workplace. The company and corporate listings use high-numbered suite/PMB-style addresses at 548 Market, which correspond to a commercial mail service; this does not establish a current physical office.
